PerfectCurse:CursedRedMask.title: Cursed Red Mask
PerfectCurse:CursedRedMask.description: At the start of each combat, gain {WeakPower} Weak.
PerfectCurse:CursedRedMask.flavor: It remembers when enemies once feared its visage.
PerfectCurse:CursedMarbleBag.title: Cursed Marble Bag
PerfectCurse:CursedMarbleBag.description: At the start of each combat, gain {VulnerablePower} Vulnerable.
PerfectCurse:CursedMarbleBag.flavor: The marbles click against each other with an ill omen.
PerfectCurse:MoldyStrawberry.title: Moldy Strawberry
PerfectCurse:MoldyStrawberry.flavor: The sweetness is long gone. The mold remains hungry.
PerfectCurse:ToxicPear.title: Toxic Pear
PerfectCurse:ToxicPear.flavor: Its flesh glistens with a poisonous sheen.
PerfectCurse:WormyMango.title: Wormy Mango
PerfectCurse:WormyMango.flavor: Something inside has already taken the first bite.
PerfectCurse:CursedAnchor.title: Cursed Anchor
PerfectCurse:CursedAnchor.description: At the start of turn #b{Round}, temporarily lose #b{DexterityLoss} Dexterity.
PerfectCurse:CursedAnchor.flavor: It drags down more than the ship.
PerfectCurse:CursedSplint.title: Cursed Splint
PerfectCurse:CursedSplint.description: At the start of turn #b{Round}, temporarily lose #b{DexterityLoss} Dexterity.
PerfectCurse:CursedSplint.flavor: The tighter it is bound, the harder it is to move.
PerfectCurse:CursedHelm.title: Cursed Helm
PerfectCurse:CursedHelm.description: At the start of turn #b{Round}, temporarily lose #b{DexterityLoss} Dexterity.
PerfectCurse:CursedHelm.flavor: Every correction turns the wheel further astray.
PerfectCurse:CursedLantern.title: Cursed Lantern
PerfectCurse:CursedLantern.description: After Energy resets on turn #b{Round}, lose #b{EnergyLoss} Energy.
PerfectCurse:CursedLantern.flavor: It lights the way by burning through your strength.
PerfectCurse:CursedCandelabra.title: Cursed Candelabra
PerfectCurse:CursedCandelabra.descriptio: After Energy resets on turn #b{Round}, lose #b{EnergyLoss} Energy.
PerfectCurse:CursedCandelabra.flavor: As the second flame catches, exhaustion deepens.
PerfectCurse:CursedChandelier.title: Cursed Chandelier
PerfectCurse:CursedChandelier.descriptio: After Energy resets on turn #b{Round}, lose #b{EnergyLoss} Energy.
PerfectCurse:CursedChandelier.flavor: Every candle sways together, burning your last strength to ash.
PerfectCurse:CursedPrayerWheel.title: Curse-Turning Wheel
PerfectCurse:CursedPrayerWheel.descripti: Normal enemies no longer grant card rewards.
PerfectCurse:CursedPrayerWheel.flavor: The wheel still turns, grinding every possibility into a curse.
PerfectCurse:CursedWhiteBeastStatue.desc: Combat victories no longer grant potion rewards.
PerfectCurse:CursedWhiteBeastStatue.flav: The pale beast silently guards potions that will never appear.
PerfectCurse:CursedStoneCalendar.title: Accursed Calendar
PerfectCurse:CursedStoneCalendar.descrip: At the end of turn #b{Round}, deal #b{Damage} damage to you and your teammates.
PerfectCurse:CursedStoneCalendar.flavor: When the seventh mark falls, the stone calendar collects from every companion.
PerfectCurse:ScientificLighter.title: Scientific Lighter
PerfectCurse:ScientificLighter.descripti: Enchanted Attack cards deal #b{DamageLoss} less damage.
PerfectCurse:ScientificLighter.flavor: Its precise flame burns only the edge from your weapons.
PerfectCurse:UndyingSeed.title: Undying Seed
PerfectCurse:UndyingSeed.description: All basic Strikes and Defends gain Eternal.
PerfectCurse:UndyingSeed.flavor: It promises eternal life, but never a way out.
PerfectCurse:CursedLavaLamp.title: Cursed Lava Lamp
PerfectCurse:CursedLavaLamp.description: If you lose HP during combat, that victory grants no card reward.
PerfectCurse:CursedLavaLamp.flavor: The lava remembers every wound and burns away the choices owed to you.
PerfectCurse:DecayingVambrace.title: Decaying Vambrace
PerfectCurse:DecayingVambrace.descriptio: The first card that grants Block each combat grants #b50% less Block.
PerfectCurse:DecayingVambrace.flavor: It still guards the arm while corroding the first line of defense.
PerfectCurse:CursedBowlerHat.title: Cursed Bowler Hat
PerfectCurse:CursedBowlerHat.flavor: A purse beneath its brim can never be filled.
PerfectCurse:BurstCannon.title: Burst Cannon
PerfectCurse:BurstCannon.description: Upgraded Attack cards deal #b{DamageLoss} less damage.
PerfectCurse:BurstCannon.flavor: Every careful modification brings the barrel closer to bursting.
PerfectCurse:DecayingFeather.title: Decaying Feather
PerfectCurse:DecayingFeather.description: When entering a Rest Site, lose #b{HpLoss} HP for every #b{Cards} cards in your deck. Cannot reduce HP below 1.
PerfectCurse:DecayingFeather.flavor: It measures not the journey, but everything you carry.
PerfectCurse:BrokenNunchaku.title: Broken Nunchaku
PerfectCurse:BrokenNunchaku.description: Every #b{Cards} Attack cards played, lose #b{EnergyLoss} Energy.
PerfectCurse:BrokenNunchaku.flavor: The broken end always strikes its owner at the worst moment.
PerfectCurse:ExpiredBloodVial.title: Expired Blood Vial
PerfectCurse:ExpiredBloodVial.descriptio: At the start of turn 1 each combat, lose #b{HpLoss} HP.
PerfectCurse:ExpiredBloodVial.flavor: The blood inside can no longer save anyone.
PerfectCurse:BrokenPotionBelt.title: Broken Potion Belt
PerfectCurse:BrokenPotionBelt.flavor: Empty leather loops remain, unable to hold another bottle.
PerfectCurse:UnexpectedRoughStone.title: Unexpectedly Rough Stone
PerfectCurse:UnexpectedRoughStone.descri: At the start of each combat, lose #b{DexterityLoss} Dexterity.
PerfectCurse:UnexpectedRoughStone.flavor: Every edge catches precisely where it hinders movement.
PerfectCurse:BrokenVajra.title: Broken Vajra
PerfectCurse:BrokenVajra.description: At the start of each combat, lose #b{StrengthLoss} Strength.
PerfectCurse:BrokenVajra.flavor: Its fracture consumes the strength once gathered within.
PerfectCurse:StoppedPendulum.title: Stopped Pendulum
PerfectCurse:StoppedPendulum.description: Every #b{Turns}rd player turn, draw #b{Cards} fewer card.
PerfectCurse:StoppedPendulum.flavor: It no longer swings, yet time still collects its price on the third toll.
PerfectCurse:CursedPlanisphere.title: Cursed Planisphere
PerfectCurse:CursedPlanisphere.descripti: Whenever you enter an Event room, lose #b{HpLoss} HP. Cannot reduce HP below 1.
PerfectCurse:CursedPlanisphere.flavor: Every unknown path converges into a wound upon its surface.
PerfectCurse:CursedMembershipCard.title: Destitute Membership Card
PerfectCurse:CursedMembershipCard.flavor: It proves your membership and the merchant's right to charge twice as much.
PerfectCurse:MaggotyBread.title: Maggoty Bread
PerfectCurse:MaggotyBread.description: Gain #b{FirstTurnEnergy} additional Energy on turn 1. Gain #b{LaterTurnEnergyLoss} less Energy on later turns.
PerfectCurse:MaggotyBread.flavor: The first bite is invigorating. Everything afterward is nausea.
